why: Brightness inverted, so the ring is faintest at the moment it lands -- the frame the entrance ends on and the one the eye actually catches. The shipped entrances all fade OUT as they expand; copying that fade here hands the converge arm the death pulse's envelope back, undoing half the separation the direction change bought.
killedBy: converge: an arrival gathers instead of expanding (issue #230) brightens as it closes, so the landing is the brightest frame
